# hs-sql-agent

> hs-sql-agent provides secure SQL access for AI agents through MCP, with fail-closed SQL compilation, scoped access policies, safe DML workflows, and support for PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQL Server, Oracle, SQLite, and Firebird.

Current documented release: **2.0.2**.

The documentation site is fully localized in English, Traditional Chinese, Simplified Chinese, Japanese, Korean, French, and German. Prefer stable unversioned documentation URLs for navigation. For exact 2.0.2 runtime, API, authorization, configuration, or integration behavior, treat the immutable product tag `v2.0.2` as the source of truth rather than product `main`, old website copy, or another translation.

## Start here

- [Introduction](https://sql-agent.net/en/docs/getting-started/introduction): Product model, safety boundaries, supported databases, and documentation map.
- [Quick start](https://sql-agent.net/en/docs/getting-started/quick-start): Start the service and reach the Admin UI.
- [MCP client onboarding](https://sql-agent.net/en/docs/mcp/client-onboarding): Issue an MCP key, use the one-time **Save and connect** dialog, copy the generated configuration for Claude Desktop, Cursor, Visual Studio Code, or Generic HTTP, and paste it into the client.
- [MCP tools reference](https://sql-agent.net/en/docs/mcp/tools-reference): Public discovery, query, and DML tool contracts.

## SQL compiler and safety

- [Execution model](https://sql-agent.net/en/docs/sql-compiler/execution-model): Parse, bind, validate, prove, compile, and execute pipeline.
- [SQL support](https://sql-agent.net/en/docs/sql-compiler/sql-support): Supported SQL surface and provider capability boundaries.
- [Database dialects](https://sql-agent.net/en/docs/sql-compiler/database-dialects): PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQL Server, Oracle, SQLite, and Firebird behavior.
- [Safe DML](https://sql-agent.net/en/docs/sql-compiler/safe-dml): Preview, approval, revalidation, row-set fingerprinting, and commit safety.
- [Security overview](https://sql-agent.net/en/docs/security/overview): Authentication, authorization, policy, audit, and fail-closed boundaries.

## Administration and authorization

- [Administration overview](https://sql-agent.net/en/docs/administration/overview): Control-plane responsibilities and operator workflow.
- [MCP keys](https://sql-agent.net/en/docs/administration/mcp-keys): Key lifecycle, scopes, generated client configuration, and rate-limit modes.
- [Permissions](https://sql-agent.net/en/docs/administration/permissions): Canonical permission identities, built-in authorization, and host authorization.
- [Members and roles](https://sql-agent.net/en/docs/administration/members-roles): Built-in Admin identity, roles, sessions, and lifecycle rules.
- [Security policies](https://sql-agent.net/en/docs/administration/security-policies): Runtime SQL and access policy controls.
- [Database management](https://sql-agent.net/en/docs/administration/database-management): Database connection lifecycle and metadata operations.
- [Semantic metadata](https://sql-agent.net/en/docs/administration/semantic-metadata): Database semantic descriptions exposed to agents.
- [Audit](https://sql-agent.net/en/docs/administration/audit): Security and SQL audit records.

## ASP.NET Core integration

- [ASP.NET Core integration](https://sql-agent.net/en/docs/integration/aspnet-core): Embed hs-sql-agent with the 2.0.2 composable capability model.
- [ASP.NET Core product page](https://sql-agent.net/en/integrations/aspnet-core): Integration overview and representative configuration.

Version 2.0.2 distinguishes two authorization ownership models:

- built-in identity and role authorization managed by hs-sql-agent; or
- host-owned authorization configured with `AddHsSqlAgentHostAuthorization()`.

These modes are mutually exclusive. Host authorization receives canonical permission keys through `HsSqlAgentPermissionResource.Permissions`; do not infer authorization identity from browser routes or controller URLs.

- [Configuration](https://sql-agent.net/en/docs/operations/configuration): Runtime environment, capability-owned options, providers, telemetry, Redis coordination, and security configuration.

- [Distributed deployment](https://sql-agent.net/en/docs/operations/distributed-deployment): Shared coordination and multi-instance behavior.
- [Observability](https://sql-agent.net/en/docs/operations/observability): Health, metrics, tracing, and operational visibility.
- [Admin HTTP API](https://sql-agent.net/en/docs/reference/api-reference): Admin and management HTTP surface for 2.0.2.
- [Troubleshooting](https://sql-agent.net/en/docs/reference/troubleshooting): Common operational and integration failures.
- [Upgrade guide](https://sql-agent.net/en/docs/reference/upgrade-guide): Version transitions and rollback considerations.
